liquidity.basis_note: Venue verified 2026-10-01: Kyberswap routes every rung $1K-$1M through one Uniswap v4 syrupUSDT/USDT 0.08% pool (id 0xd861038a…8e1d, ~$5.0M reserve, ~$190K 24h volume per GeckoTerminal). A SECONDARY market mark, not the Maple withdrawal queue. Single venue: depth is that pool's, and its v4 hook (if any) was not inspected. Plasma pools exist (Oku ~$2.7M reserve) but traded ~$0 in 24h and are not configured.
liquidity.slippage_bps_basis: PRICE IMPACT against this venue's own smallest quoted rung, which EXCLUDES that rung's own spread — it is not the holder's all-in cost. The all-in figure is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Impact is measured this way deliberately, so peg discount and source lag do not leak into it.
liquidity.fill_ratio_basis: ALL-IN against notional: output_usd / size, where size is converted to tokens at fair_value. Includes the venue's base spread and any gap between fair_value and the venue. 1.0 = exits at fair value; (fill_ratio - 1) * 10000 is the all-in cost in bps.

depth.two_pct_depth_basis: A FLOOR, not a measurement. The deepest rung quoted ($1,000,000) still clears inside 200bps, so the crossing is somewhere above where we look. Publishing it as '2% depth' would read as a limit we found. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL over the fill (not marginal impact at the margin), measured against this venue's own smallest quoted rung. ⚠️ That reference EXCLUDES the smallest rung's own spread, so the figure is price impact and NOT the holder's all-in cost — which is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Both are real and they answer different questions. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal and under impact vs all-in, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.

depth_50bps.basis: A FLOOR, not a measurement. The deepest rung quoted ($1,000,000) still clears inside 50bps, so the crossing is somewhere above where we look. Publishing it as '0.5% depth' would read as a limit we found. backing.collateral_ratio_basis: Principal collateral ratio: (free USDC + sum of strategy assetsUnderManagement) / pool.totalAssets(). Three INDEPENDENT contract reads, so ~100% is the vault's components agreeing with its own accounting, not an identity — a shortfall would show. ⚠️ total_supply is denominated in SHARES: total_backing/total_supply is assets-per-share (a NAV, ~1.18) and NOT a coverage ratio. The two figures answer different questions.
backing.surplus_deficit_basis: pool.totalAssets() minus its independently-read components — the reconciliation residual, currently a few dollars on a book of hundreds of millions. NOT backing minus supply, which would be meaningless here because supply is in shares.
